title: Concept: Module relocated to other coordinates
description: pom.xml declares a relocation block that redirects the module, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a relocation block that redirects the module.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a relocation block that redirects the module.
